notes.title: Ver16 - Small Fixes and Hints
notes.notes:
Ver16 is live now, featuring a few small fixes:
[list]
[*] a fix for a bug where gem-porting out of the Clock puzzle with a plug lifted could wedge the puzzle
[*] a small hint for the final puzzle
[*] adjusted the solution to the Clock puzzle for less purple frustration
[*] slight change in the outro sequence
[/list]

Thanks to everyone for the bug notes and suggestions.

(You can always spot the current version in the lower right of the credits screen.)

notes.title: The Cubedex of Brass and Wood Q&A + Livestream
notes.notes:
Join me, Jim McCann, sole proprietor of TCHOW llc and creator of The Cubedex of Brass and Wood, as I walk through some game assets, talk about puzzle design, show off the game, and answer your questions. I'll be doing my best not to spoil any puzzle solutions during the broadcast.

[b]Ask questions in Stream Chat on the day of the event, or in the discussion below![/b] I'll try to get to every single one of them.
